Please make sure the source file is really in <declared source unit>.'; the dry run carries the same reminder; the header status reads 'checks passed'. The engine script is unchanged. 2026-09-29.1 (interface script): readiness line naming what is missing; the settings-changed message says to tick the confirmation again; a declaration summary with the engine's exact factor; unit clues from header coordinate fields and '# units:' comments only (never the file name) at three levels, contradiction with explicit buttons and Keep my choice, agreement, disagreeing labels, always noting labels can be outdated; a before/after example of the largest coordinate using the value actually written; a legacy U.S. survey foot note. The engine script is unchanged. 2026-09-29.2 (owner decisions D1-D3): a fresh page starts at 8 decimals (a reopened handoff keeps its own); an unchosen unit field stands out once a file is loaded; 'Written decimals are output precision, not survey accuracy' under the decimals field; the result states the control-point check (points within tolerance, or none entered). The engine script is unchanged. Also 1.3: disagreeing unit labels note that the same factor is applied to every coordinate column. 2026-09-30.1 (page text and CSS only; all scripts unchanged): the source unit reference is labelled optional and connected to its input, with a folded 'What should I write here?' note (explanation, four examples, when it helps). The control-points fold-out has a stable id (ctrlFold) so that tests open it by name. 2026-10-01.1 (Windows review of ff68746): F1 a label naming both feet is ambiguous; F2 the stale-label warning compares the exact unit with the output (bare ft stays unresolved); F3 the 500-line clue scan discloses its scope; F4 exact comparison selects the example for every numeric form; F5 readiness and buttons refresh once the worker is active; S1 'Download requested: name'; S2 keyboard-reachable file input and programmatic labels; S4 legacy wording; S5 source-drawing example; S6 the example decodes only its own output line. The engine script is unchanged. Version 3.3.7 (2026-10-01.2): the only change in the engine script and in pointfile_units.py is the version string (3.3.6 to 3.3.7; verified as the sole difference); arithmetic untouched. Interface: ticking the box again replaces the stale 'tick again' message; 'Check your units' has its own style (full orange border, white, '!' badge) distinct from the standing 'Which foot?' box; an unresolved warning is repeated under the Convert button. 2026-10-02.1 (PFU-01 / Windows review N1 of d4ef080): an active run (S.active) independent of the worker lasts from start through fingerprint, standalone verification and publication; phases Converting then Verifying; Convert and Preview stay disabled and readiness says Verifying until the run ends; Cancel stays available while verifying; cancel, invalidation and loading end the active run at once (the revision bump already removes its authority to publish); a rejected fingerprint or verification shows 'Verification could not be completed; nothing was published' and recovers; endRun is token-safe; the fingerprint promise is now returned so the run cannot end before verification; run() refuses a second launch while active. Engine unchanged.
